title: Mary, Martha
html_source:
Vermeer
- Christ in the House of Martha and Mary.

Luke 10 – Christ visits Lazarus, Mary and Martha. Mary talks to Christ which annoys Martha who is left doing chores. Christ asks her to see the big picture !

Joyce also presents us with the irreverent twinning of a biblical Mary and Martha Clifford.
